scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml down -v --remove-orphans; docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml up -d && node e2e/seed.mjs
scripts.e2e:test: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:up && npm run e2e:test; status=$?; npm run e2e:down; exit $status
